card.name: The word private (vs. public)
card.fires_on: The word "private" used as an adjective for non-government things, such as private schools, companies, investors, sector or property. It often sits next to "public".

modes.label: Private beside public
modes.description: "private" follows "public and" in a contrast of sectors.
modes.example: ESDs link local public and<< private>> schools with state and national educational resources.

modes.label: Private as ownership or sector
modes.description: "private" describes who owns or funds something, such as a company, school, investors or lawsuits.
